title: 特別支援教育概論（春期集中講義）
subtitle: Introduction to Special Supported Education
educationalGoal: In the current education, the support for handicapped students is very important. Special supported education is significance not only for specific students but also for all students. The objectives of this course are to understand basic knowledge of special need education, and to consider the adequate methods for it.
advice:
This course covers items as below.
 1. Inclusive education
 2. The system for special supported education
 3. Specific methods for special supported education
 4. Organizational initiatives for special supported education
Students will learn basic knowledge of special need education, and acquire the adequate perspective on "handicap".
requiredKnowledge:
●Students should be especially aware that the content of this course is necessary for those who wish to be beyond special supported schools.
●Student who aim to be a teacher must attend this course.

activityGoals.body: Be able to answer questions about students who needs special support.
Be able to answer the questions about the features and the development of students who needs special support.
Be able to answer the questions about curriculum and support for students who needs special support.
Be able to answer the questions about support for students without handicap who needs special support.
Be able to describe the significant strategies for students with and without handicap.
Engage in this course and self-evaluate objectives of this course to be achieved.

              In the current education, the support for handicapped students is very important. Special supported education is significance not only for specific students but also for all students. The objectives of this course are to understand basic knowledge of special need education, and to consider the adequate methods for it.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              This course covers items as below.
 1. Inclusive education
 2. The system for special supported education
 3. Specific methods for special supported education
 4. Organizational initiatives for special supported education
Students will learn basic knowledge of special need education, and acquire the adequate perspective on "handicap".
